scope: MEAS: independent gates/report, source, published bar-map, listen pointers and complete-recording visual coverage; not aural review.

report.finding: Report agrees with final checks: two piano staves / 400 notes, 32 performed bar occurrences, correct first/second endings, corrected 34.813125 s final chord and one-page 21-bar sheet. It discloses the very soft penultimate note’s less-secure interior timing rather than claiming exactness for every onset.

barMap.finding: All 400 note bar/voice indices resolve, durations are positive and performed bar times strictly increase. Actual SVG/index sets are exactly 1–21. The entire rendered page was inspected, including repeat beginning at 9, first ending 20 and second ending 21. Both corrected listen bar-9 occurrence-1 pointers resolve uniquely at 8.505 s.

resolvedFindings.finding: RomA4 moved the section-B start from 12 to 8.5 s and anchored the second-part cue/transition to bar 9 occurrence 1. The 12 s novelty is now identified as internal slurred contrast near bar 13, not the second-part boundary. Repeat commentary distinguishes the provisional aligned order from an aural certification.

overlays.finding: These windows cover the complete recording. No gross pitch/order mismatch identified. The true very quiet final chord near 34.813 s is retained instead of terminating at the earlier B-based event near 32.599 s. The penultimate soft semiquaver’s timing remains explicitly uncertain; the 35.68 s display end is not a measured key release.

version.finding: Complete No. 3 for piano in coherent performed order 1–20, 9–19, 21: first eight bars once, second part repeated with its two distinct endings. No gross cut/arrangement mismatch identified in full-recording visual coverage.
version.physicalPerformingEdition: Unknown; the symbolic-source edition is not asserted to be the performer’s physical copy.

sourceInventoryAudit.finding: Subsequent independent isolated-source audit finds all 265 canonical distinct pitch-onsets and every written tied/final hold already retained. The 268 raw source events add only three coincident unisons; 179 duration-multiset differences are 176 modern staccato-rendering changes plus three unison collapses, not shortened written holds. The performed raw-source difference (406 versus 400) is likewise solely duplicated unisons. Existing publication stands unchanged; this audit is not additional listening evidence.

limitations: MEAS: No aural review, build or browser integration check performed by VerS. Passing medians and three anchors do not establish every very soft interior onset; that limitation must remain visible.
